newsitem.title: UK: Gold fixed at 5-wk high, palladium races higher.
newsitem.headline: Gold fixed at 5-wk high, palladium races higher.

text.p: GOLD - Fixes at highest level in five weeks of $345.85 vs $344.80. Technically healthy, but $350 to attract good selling.
SILVER - Steady at $4.83/$4.84 but needs to overcome $4.85.
PLATINUM - Maintains gains amid tight forward market. Indicated $6.50 higher at $382.50/$383.50.
PALLADIUM - Races higher as Russian export delays keep lending market squeezed. Up a steep $6.90 at $165.30/$166.30.
